changelog.message: op created to emit global virtual macOS keystrokes using a native background sidecar process
changelog.author: Antigravity

summary: Emits virtual keystrokes and modifier key combinations globally on macOS using a high-performance native background sidecar process.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Starts or stops the native Swift KeyboardController sidecar process and its WebSocket listener.

ports.name: Emit
ports.text: Fires a trigger to synthesize and emit the virtual keystroke globally.

ports.name: Keystroke Object
ports.text: An object containing 'key' (e.g. 'a', 'space', 'escape') and 'modifier' (e.g. 'cmd', 'shift', 'cmd + shift') properties.

ports.name: Emitted Keystroke
ports.text: The formatted string of the last successfully emitted key and modifier combination.

ports.name: On Emitted
ports.text: Fires a trigger every time a virtual keystroke is successfully emitted globally.

ports.name: Running
ports.text: True if the native keyboard control sidecar process is running.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Human-readable status of the Swift sidecar process.
